info.title: Pocket Alert API
info.summary: Send push notifications to iOS and Android devices.
info.description:
REST API of Pocket Alert (https://pocketalert.app). One authenticated request delivers a push notification to the account's phones. Also covers applications (channels), devices, webhook receivers, forms and API keys.

Authenticate with an API key in the `Token` header (https://pocketalert.app/account/apikeys) or a JWT in `Authorization: Bearer`. Full guide: https://pocketalert.app/auth.md

Official SDKs: Node.js (`npm i pocketalert`), Python (`pip install pocketalert`), Go (`github.com/PocketAlert/pocketalert-go`), PHP (`composer require pocketalert/pocketalert-php`).

Errors are JSON `{"error": "..."}`. Timestamps named `created_at`/`deliver_at` use the display format `DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM:SS` in the account timezone; `*_utc` and `resets_at` are RFC 3339.

post.description: Delivers a notification to every device on the account, or to one device when `device_id` is set. With `send_at`/`delay` in the future the message is stored and delivered later (paid plans). Each accepted request counts toward the daily limit; rejected ones do not.

get.description: Returns every message unless `limit` is set. Prefer `GET /v2/messages` for paging.

Tid.name: tid
Tid.description: Resource identifier used by the API instead of a numeric id

DailyLimit.description: Daily message limit (absent on unlimited plans)

Forbidden.description: Not available on the current plan, or plan limit reached

Conflict.description: The resource is in a state that does not allow the operation

DailyLimit.description: Daily message limit reached; nothing was stored

ServerError.description: Server error; also returned for missing resources with `record not found`

DisplayTime.description: Timestamp rendered as `DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM:SS` in the account timezone (not ISO 8601).

Level.description: Delivery level as a name or an integer. Aliases are accepted too: `min` = silent, `normal` = default, `max`/`urgent` = critical. `critical` bypasses Do Not Disturb and is a paid feature; free plans get `high`.

Priority.description: Resolved level: -2 silent, -1 low, 0 default, 1 high, 2 critical

Action.description: Notification action button (paid plans; silently dropped on free plans).

type.description: `view` opens a URL, `http` fires a background request, `copy` copies text

value.description: `view`: an http(s) URL. `http`: a JSON string `{"url": ..., "method": ..., "headers": {...}, "body": ...}`. `copy`: literal text.

device_id.description: Device TID, or `all`. Omit to reach every device.

send_at.description: Deliver later (paid plans): RFC 3339, Unix seconds, or `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM` in the account timezone. At most 30 days ahead. Mutually exclusive with `delay`.

delay.description: Deliver after a relative delay (paid plans): `30m`, `2h`, `1d`, or bare seconds.

image.description: Image attachment (paid plans): an http(s) URL to download, a data URL, or base64.

level.description: Level name or integer as text

application.description: Application name, when one was set

device.description: Device name, when one device was targeted

ScheduledMessageCreated.description: Message stored for delayed delivery (returned when `send_at` or `delay` is in the future).

rejected.description: Requests rejected today by the limit

default_level.description: Level used when a message sets none. -2 silent, -1 low, 0 default, 1 high, 2 critical

actions.description: JSON-encoded actions template, empty when none

WebhookInput.description: Update replaces every field: send the full object, omitted fields are cleared.

message.description: Template rendered from the incoming JSON. `*` outputs the whole payload; `%field.path%` extracts values.

url.description: Custom slug; generated when omitted on create

default_level.description: Create only. -2 silent, -1 low, 0 default, 1 high, 2 critical

actions.description: JSON-encoded array of up to 3 Action; `label`/`value` may contain `%field.path%`

param.description: Hidden fields: URL query parameter to read
